metadata.title: Attention Divergence Score: Canonical Reproducibility Release — Post-Phase-2
metadata.description: Canonical post-audit reproducibility package for the IEEE TIFS manuscript 'Attention Divergence Score: A Forensic Metric for Characterizing Parameter-Level Attacks in Vision Transformers'. This version aligns the public archival payload with Ledger v1.62 and the closed v1.5.2 submission (12-page main, 6-page supplement). Packaging introduces no new experiment or scientific result. The release preserves explicit archival gaps and does not duplicate the approximately 401 GB densified-stress delta payload.
